spec.name: Zellij Mosque
spec.description: The Zellij Mosque (Masjid al-Zellij) is an ancient place of worship located in the Hay al-Diwan neighborhood, one of the oldest districts in the medina of Ksar el-Kebir. The mosque is historically noted for its decorative traditional Moroccan tilework (zellij), from which it derives its name. It stands as a significant landmark of the city's spiritual and architectural heritage.

timeline.title: Construction
timeline.description: Construction of the mosque in the historic Hay al-Diwan district.

timeline.title: Closure for Restoration
timeline.description: The mosque is closed for safety reasons and structural concerns, leading to a period of planned restoration.
